label: Completion Rate
description: Percentage of enrollments that are active or completed.
formula_plain_english: percentage of enrollments where transaction_status is a completed value
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN {{transaction_status}} IN {{completed_values}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS completion_percent, COUNT(*) AS total_enrollments FROM {{fact}}
